title: 54 - Stuff is Happening
summary: Eighteen months out from [[location:gliese-877]] on the way back to [[location:gliese-54]], [[character:hal]] is travelling too fast for real-time contact, even frame-jacked, so news reaches him by email. [[character:bill]] writes that a squad of [[species:others|Others]] vessels has left GL 877 for GL 54, possibly just to scavenge, and that Bob scouts find closer systems already stripped. [[character:mario]] is pulling out with all his equipment. The Bobs will leave drones to watch and one to try talking to the Others, to be blown up if a Death Asteroid is turned on it. Bill expects formal first contact and suggests Hal re-route.

updates.current_state: Eighteen months out from [[location:gliese-877]] toward [[location:gliese-54]], too fast for real-time talk even frame-jacked, he got [[character:bill]]'s email: an [[species:others|Others]] squad left GL 877 for GL 54, [[character:mario]] is pulling out, and Bill suggests he re-route.
With a squad of [[species:others|Others]] vessels heading from [[location:gliese-877]] toward [[location:gliese-54]], he has decided to leave, taking every piece of equipment he has.

He emailed [[character:hal]] that an [[species:others|Others]] squad is heading for [[location:gliese-54]]. The Bobs will leave drones there to watch and one to try talking to the Others, to be blown up if a Death Asteroid is turned on it; he expects formal first contact.

updates.state: In 2197 a squad of [[species:others|Others]] vessels was seen heading here from [[location:gliese-877]]. [[character:mario]] is leaving with all his equipment; the Bobs will leave drones to watch and to try contacting the Others. Mario's [[technology:relay-station|relay station]] was built here.
